item.title: Thousands of FFA Students Experience Husker Harvest Days
item.description: Nearly 3,000 FFA members take over Husker Harvest Days! From hands-on learning to exploring the latest ag technology, students from more than 120 chapters across Nebraska and neighboring states are building leadership skills, discovering careers, and making an impact — all while having a blast at one of the nation’s largest farm shows.
